indicators.label: Four-construct religion denominator
indicators.description: People counted in the four retained INEGI religion constructs: Catholic, Protestant/evangelical/biblical, other religion, and no religion.
indicators.method: For each built wave, sum the four retained ITER constructs after using INEGI municipality total rows.
indicators.spatial_coverage: Mexico municipalities on INEGI 2020 Marco Geoestadistico boundaries
indicators.quality_notes: The denominator is the sum of four top-level INEGI ITER constructs. The 2000 file is not mapped because it does not expose those four constructs separately.

indicators.label: Religious affiliation %
indicators.description: Share of the four-construct denominator in Catholic, Protestant/evangelical/biblical, or other-religion categories.
indicators.spatial_coverage: Mexico municipalities on INEGI 2020 Marco Geoestadistico boundaries
indicators.quality_notes: The denominator is the sum of four top-level INEGI ITER constructs. The 2000 file is not mapped because it does not expose those four constructs separately.

indicators.label: No religion %
indicators.description: Share of the four-construct denominator in the INEGI no-religion/no-affiliation category.
indicators.spatial_coverage: Mexico municipalities on INEGI 2020 Marco Geoestadistico boundaries
indicators.quality_notes: The denominator is the sum of four top-level INEGI ITER constructs. The 2000 file is not mapped because it does not expose those four constructs separately.

visual_layers.label: Religious affiliation %
visual_layers.description: Mexico census four-construct religion affiliation share.
visual_layers.notes: 2010 rows use 2020 boundaries without a split/merge concordance; 2000 is not rendered because it lacks the four separate constructs.

visual_layers.label: No religion %
visual_layers.description: Mexico census no-religion share in the retained four-construct denominator.
visual_layers.notes: The no-religion label is PSIN_RELIG in 2020 and psin_relig in 2010.
